```artifact
Feature: Alarms GUI Control

  Scenario Outline: Set HIGH RR alarm threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold should be set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 5         |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Set LOW RR alarm threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold should be set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 5         |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Set apnea alarm threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the apnea alarm threshold should be set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 1         |
      | 5         |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario: Set HIGH RR alarm threshold to invalid value
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 31
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold should remain unchanged

  Scenario: Set LOW RR alarm threshold to invalid value
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 31
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold should remain unchanged

  Scenario: Set apnea alarm threshold to invalid value
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 31
    Then the apnea alarm threshold should remain unchanged

  Scenario: Set HIGH RR alarm threshold to boundary value
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 5
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold should be set to 5

  Scenario: Set LOW RR alarm threshold to boundary value
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 5
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold should be set to 5

  Scenario: Set apnea alarm threshold to boundary value
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 1
    Then the apnea alarm threshold should be set to 1

  Scenario: Relief valve alarm triggered
    Given the GUI is open
    And the relief valve is open
    When the flow increases unexpectedly
    Then the relief valve alarm should be triggered
```
